notes: Unmodified generated raster assets. Opaque dark item cards; painted inventory UI only, no actor or environment replacement.

entries.prompt: Asset type: finished background painting for a dark historical action RPG inventory menu, 16:9 landscape. Original Swedish seventeenth-century expedition field chest interior, viewed straight down as a flat 2D painted interface backdrop. Beautiful rich old oil-painting surface detail: deep brown distressed leather, nearly black indigo wool lining, worn dark oak edges, restrained tarnished bronze corner fittings with subtle Nordic knot engravings, a few weathered blank parchment edges tucked under the OUTERMOST corners. Center and inner panels must remain broad empty dark low-contrast material with quiet grain for legible cream game text and item icons laid over it. Strong detail confined to thin outer borders and corners, not across the middle. Layout: leave the top 12%, center 80% and bottom 10% visually quiet, no illustrated boxes, no inventory slots, no controls. Muted umber, charcoal, dark blue-grey and aged bronze; matte, serious and worn. Hand-painted 2D game art with fine restrained brush texture, rich atmosphere rather than flat vector art. No lettering, words, numbers, logos, maps, weapons, armour, objects in the central area, no UI mockup, no people, no glossy plastic, no 3D render.

Production 2D inventory item icon for a dark Nordic historical action RPG. ONE item only: a slender seventeenth-century officer's saber, gently curved steel blade, small worn brass knuckle guard, dark leather wrapped hilt. Entire sword diagonally lower-left hilt to upper-right tip. Beautiful serious hand-painted oil illustration, realistic historical proportions, subtle deliberate brushwork, worn matte material, strong clean silhouette readable at 56 pixels. Dim upper-left painted highlights on raised details, no glossy reflections. Restrained indigo, warm iron grey, umber leather and aged bronze palette. Opaque uniform very dark charcoal-green background (#111612), with no scene, no floor, no frame, no drop shadow. This is a finished raster inventory icon, not a photograph, 3D render, concept sheet or vector glyph. No text, letters, labels, runic writing, logos, hands, people, mannequin or extra objects.
